notes: The series stops before ios-sweet's filesystem, AMFI, USB, input, display and SMP work; those are later milestones.
A clean apply proves text-level composition against the pinned tag only. It says nothing about compiling, linking, booting, or the phone.
The platform expert matches 'xiaomi,sweet', so a QEMU device tree must publish that compatible value before XNU can instantiate it.
